# P14 — End-to-end

**Goal:** prove the whole system works together, and keep proving it on every PR.

**Read first:** PRD §5, §6, §11; `03-testing.md` §1.

## Tasks

1. **Stack fixture** — `test/e2e/stack.sh`: `docker compose up --wait`, migrate, seed,
   and print URLs; fake SMS/FCM adapters expose captured messages on a test-only endpoint
   (enabled only when `APP_ENV=test`) so tests can read OTPs.
2. **API journeys** (`test/e2e/api`, Go, black-box HTTP only):
   - provider enrols → admin approves → Level 1 → goes online;
   - customer signs up → finds provider → books ASAP → provider accepts → on the way →
     arrived → wrong code ×2 → right code → extras proposed → approved → completed →
     both rate → receipts and earnings correct;
   - reject path, timeout path, customer cancel before start, cancel blocked after start;
   - document expiry → provider hidden from search → renew → visible again;
   - ban → tokens revoked → cannot sign in again with same phone;
   - RBAC: each admin role sees only its endpoints.
3. **App journeys** — run the Patrol suites from P11–P13 against the stack in CI
   (Android emulator job + Chrome job). Shared test IDs (`Key`s) follow screen IDs.
4. **Performance** — k6 scripts: nearby search p95 < 300 ms at 50 rps; request → provider
   notification < 3 s (PRD §11). Fail the job if thresholds are missed.
5. **Smoke** — `main.go` / `main.dart` composition roots covered by a start-up smoke test
   (the documented coverage exclusion).

## Definition of done

`e2e.yml` is green and required on `main`. `./pao ci` green; PR merged.
